# Aevum OS — Standalone Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server & Decoupled Workspace External Brain

> Aevum OS is an independent workspace Operating System and External Brain — housing domain-driven planning, self-healing memory graphs, and autonomous multi-agent squad orchestration completely decoupled from traditional IDE editors.

## System Mission & Core Value
Aevum OS solves the fundamental problem of **AI Short-Term Context Amnesia** in developer workflows. By running as an independent background daemon (SSE / Stdio) communicating via standard Model Context Protocol (MCP), Aevum OS gives AI Coding Agents persistent long-term memory, domain-driven architecture plan enforcement, and collaborative multi-agent execution across Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, and CLI environments.

## Architectural Pillars
- **Decoupled Workspace External Brain**: Operates as a standalone OS process independent of any single IDE lifecycle.
- **Handshake Ritual**: Cryptographic session initialization between daemon and client agents via temporary signal tokens (`.aevum/signal.json`).
- **Domain-Driven Design (DDD) Planning**: Structured architectural domains, feature manifests, and plan step tracking (`.aevum/domains/`) requiring agents to plan before writing code.
- **Living Memory Graph**: Multi-layered persistent context store (`.aevum/global/memory.md`) with continuous consolidation, decay auditing, and EXP progression.
- **Autonomous Multi-Agent Squad Orchestration**: Role-specialized AI personas collaborating concurrently with automatic task handoff.
- **PiperNet (Internet of Agents - IoA)**: Decentralized P2P knowledge mesh for cross-workspace wisdom sharing without source code leakage.

## Product Tiers & Pricing
- **Community Tier (Free Forever)**: 100% Local-First MCP daemon, unlimited local memory graph storage, single agent execution.
- **Pro Tier ($19/mo or $190/yr with 14-Day Free Beta Trial)**: Cloud Sync, Multi-Agent Squad Orchestration, PiperNet IoA Mesh, and priority engineering support.
